title: Machine Learning: What Changes, and Why?
judgment: The best moments are specific: loss rules judge the same observations differently, k-means still demands four centres from an unclustered sample, and `ML_Sequence_Memory/final.md` makes two histories with the same last token yield different retained states. The linear, hand-set cell is a legitimate teaching simplification. Its three-metre endpoint, however, limits what a normal reach can set.
concrete_findings: The sequence repeatedly asks visitors to investigate missing evidence. `ML_Neural_Networks/final.md` says training finishes without a restart; Perception describes unresponsive interaction promises; Generative clearly identifies scripted losses. That honesty protects the claims, but repeated diagnosis can crowd out the pleasure of making a learner work.
prior_new_carry_forward_capacity: brings objective-dependent memory and weighted updates; adds distinctions among learned state, activation, input evidence and judgement; carries a disciplined account of representation into graphs. It does not establish broad independent ML implementation. The neural tutorial's backpropagation sketch omits activation derivatives and propagates through weights already changed in the loop. The generative tutorial calls undefined training methods while claiming GAN and VAE capability.
focused_intervention: prioritise one restartable tiny learner with a correct supplied update, an editable forward calculation and a held-out case. Keep the generative diagram modest; its storyboard's fixed critic is a better first construction than three model families.
confidence: high on document and code-sketch gaps; moderate on visitor timing claims, taken from the finals.

title: Foundations Crisis: The Limits of Formalization
judgment: The current finals avoid the easy collapse of geometry, contradiction, incompleteness, illusion and disagreement into one mystical “limit”. `NonEuclidean_Spaces/final.md` distinguishes geodesics from bowed pictures; Russell tests both membership answers and bounded filtering; Brouwer lets the row wait for a choice. Florensky's permeable ghost leaves preserve an embodied question about passage without claiming that overlapping meshes implement a logic. These are substantial encounters.
concrete_findings: The severe weakness is the making material. `Godel_Incompleteness/tutorial.md` converts a bounded “not found” into a verdict of true-but-unprovable; its lossy encoding does not supply the promised construction. This directly undoes the final's central caution. `Crisis_Synthesis/tutorial.md` also presents a complete summit and lambda-driven bifurcation where the final explicitly keeps the logistic parameter independent and QFEP unproved. Its later sentence-authority exercise is much better scoped.
prior_new_carry_forward_capacity: brings concrete constructions and graph claims; adds a way to name assumptions, witnesses, checks and distinct limits; carries questions that QFEP must answer. It grants no mathematical warrant to QFEP.
focused_intervention: replace the Gödel sketch with the storyboard's bounded proof-checking example and preserve the sculpture as sculpture. Bring the synthesis tutorial into agreement with the independent experiments.
confidence: high; these contradictions are explicit in the documents.
method: Read-only documentary review; all current finals and assigned authored storyboards; selected complete tutorials. No new runtime, VR, learner or external-theory tests.

final_three_boundary_assessment: Foundations asks what warrants a claim; QFEP asks what its own quantities and connections actually do; Post-crisis asks what someone can revise and meet again. That progression holds without turning the first into a proof of the second or the third into an ethics score. Its cumulative capacity is strongest as careful making, situated comparison and return. Independent algorithm construction is still uneven. The priority is to repair the few tutorials that teach a false conclusion, then complete selected small constructions already identified in the storyboards. More interfaces throughout the museum would not supply that missing continuity.

Lambda's light can recommend a blocked route. These are effective returns to earlier operations.
concrete_findings: `QFEP_Edge_Of_Chaos/final.md` adds a particularly valuable capacity: compare equal model time with different numerical steps. Sandbox exposes a disconnected control and a receiver that retains its last input. Synthesis separates stiffness, pressure, damping and ongoing motion. The terms are allowed to acquire specified local consequences instead of certifying life or queerness.

title: Post-Crisis: Applied Limits
judgment: The first five halls risk another run of “the apparatus has an author”, but the operations differ: compression, arrangement, retained disagreement, located images, and revision with provenance. The witness cameras and commons table give partial accounts somewhere to coexist. They should not be reduced to terminology quizzes.
concrete_findings: The decisive acceleration is the last three halls. `SpeculativeComputation_Rhizome_Network/final.md` makes a circuit a return experienced from inside, including a crossing where no turn exists. Assembly distinguishes moved coordinates, changed neighbours and constraints that transmit a pull. `PostCrisis_Synthesis/final.md` then returns the visitor's released pose and connections beside their start. Earlier points, arrays, transforms, graphs, mechanics and records now serve an authored body.
prior_new_carry_forward_capacity: brings the entire constructive vocabulary; adds revisable relation and durable reconstruction; carries a specific desired next operation. Source inspection confirms the shared record writer, readers and final map's `visitor_record:true`; this is stronger evidence than a storyboard promise, though not a new runtime test. Only the latest pose survives, without identity or gesture history.
focused_intervention: update the Assembly and final tutorials first: they still call editable relations future work and describe a fictitious scrolling ledger. Optional two-version storage is a good next lesson, not a condition for the existing ending to hold. Keep walking before the rhizome controls.
confidence: high on the source-supported transfer and documentary drift; physical comfort remains unassessed.
